top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a nameable phenomenon predicted from symmetry and spin-orbit band structure (Kane and Mele's Z2 insulator) and decisively observed (Molenkamp's quantised HgTe edge conductance), with nearly two decades of independent confirmation and wide use of the classification in electronic-structure work. The three credited names map cleanly onto the narrowed two-dimensional citation, which neither claims the three-dimensional work nor ignores the experiment. P002 is a mature, reproduced invention with a clean two-name allocation and ranks second; P003 is exact and well tested but its credit is more contested and P000 is last because at least two proposals are scientifically mature.
